g.text: Foundational Forensic Evidentiary Principle of DNA Methylation [Nau23, Vid18]

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: • DNA methylation modifies the chemical state of DNA without altering the underlying inherited nucleotide sequence [Nau23].

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: • It provides investigative intelligence regarding chronological age, tissue source, or exposures, NOT direct proof of identity.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: • Epigenetic predictions cannot individualize a person and must be corroborated by autonomous autosomal STR profiling [Vid18].

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #8c8c8c
